answer: The inlet schedule is applied in quartz and mesa shows each instalment. An attacker thus cannot take the money and run, as most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A payout is split so that 43% arrives at settlement and the rest over 18 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 4721 identities would post 4184 proofs and burn roughly 10 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
